Both have the same primary product (newly constructed homes), the same buyer (B2C residential homebuyers, including first-time and move-up buyers [T:P1.17, C:P1.11]), the same value chain position (build-to-sell homebuilder using subcontractors), and overlapping geographies. This is a direct competitor.

T:P1.1.text: New Home Builders In Your Area - KB Home

T:P1.2.text: KB Home builds homes for the way you live. Find new homes for sale with open floor plans, energy-efficient features and personalize to fit your style.

T:P1.3.text: We build homes for all of life’s small but epic moments. That’s why we put our experience in the service of your dreams and partner with you to design a new home that reflects your style and budget. We devote our attention to you. We listen to you. And we do all of that before we even break ground. Because we see you.
